title: Junkstronaut spec audit report
description: The Spec Auditor's output. A fail routes back as a bug report to whichever agent owns the artifact the rule is about — catalog rules to the Debris Designer, parameter rules to the Economy Balancer — per the `owner` label on each check. The auditor labels; the orchestrator, not the auditor, decides what happens next.

owner.description: Which agent's artifact this rule is about, and therefore which agent a failure routes back to. The auditor labels; the orchestrator dispatches. Labelling is a judgement about the data; dispatching on the label is not, which is what keeps control flow deterministic.
